detail.q: Is R1 the man in the black cap whose inner arm is linked with R2's inner arm, rather than R2 being the man in the black cap?
detail.evidence: R1 is the capped man on the left linked with R2

detail.q: Is R2 the woman in the white patterned t-shirt whose inner arm is linked with R1's inner arm, rather than R1 being the woman in the white patterned t-shirt?
detail.evidence: R2 is the woman in the white patterned t-shirt

detail.q: Does R1 keep his outer hand on his own hip while linked arm-in-arm with R2?
detail.evidence: R1's outer hand is on his hip

detail.q: Does R2 keep her outer hand on her own hip while linked arm-in-arm with R1?
detail.evidence: R2's outer hand is on her hip
